payload.name: Cognitive Drift
payload.fact: Cognitive Drift is a phenomenon where systems gradually lose context, grounding, or semantic fidelity while remaining functional.
payload.boundary: The process occurs in mediated systems where external tools and AI participate in memory and reasoning.

provenance.title: Cognition in Mediated Systems: AI Memory, External Thought, Decision Fatigue, and Co-Cognition
provenance.quote_or_locus: It also examines how these systems can remain coherent and useful while gradually losing context, grounding, or semantic fidelity, creating the conditions for Cognitive Drift
